reasons.action: The brief explicitly requests a performed behavior — the car pulling forward — which is a new action rather than a static pose, so action is request-governed.
reasons.medium: The medium decision preserves the source rendering family; the live-action cinematic look comes from the supplied style reference, so medium remains reference-governed.
reasons.wardrobe: No clothing or accessory change is requested and no figure wardrobe is observed, so this attribute stays with the request side as specified by the contract.
reasons.lighting: The request describes the car emerging "out of the dark," an instruction about the visible quality of light in the scene, so lighting is request-governed rather than inherited from the reference.
reasons.framing: The request contains no camera composition, shot scale, viewpoint or camera movement; a subject moving forward is not a framing instruction, so framing stays with the reference.
reasons.palette: No color grading, saturation or contrast treatment is requested — darkness is a lighting property, not a palette instruction — so the reference's tonal treatment is retained.
